svg.aria-label: Three cards from broad to narrow. Everywhere: Grayscale on, Extra Warmth off, Night Shift on, so the picture is gray. On example.com: Grayscale is set to off, so the site shows in color, and warmth and Night Shift are kept. On the single page example.com/reading: Extra Warmth is set to 30 percent, so the picture is in warm color, and Night Shift is kept.
